source_acquisition.search_note: Source inventory row 233 names THUIR/MemoryBench and a Hugging Face dataset, but marks no_public_source_found. The verified PDF/README links THUIR/MemoryBench, whose README points to the full reproduction repository LittleDinoC/MemoryBench-code. GitHub main trees were inspected at the current commits (THUIR/MemoryBench main: 5eafebca4e9ffbb2f0087ade13c498cf95fbc09a; MemoryBench-code main metadata updated 2026-05-07). They contain evaluation/run/config/data code but no paper-specific plot*, figure*, visual*, table-generation, TeX/TikZ/PGF, notebook, or non-vendored figure assets. paper_style.palette_strategy: 正文框架图使用绿色/橙色/蓝色角色色；主结果使用八色分类柱与蓝橙成本柱；附录轨迹多用单蓝色，动作机制用珊瑚色，鲁棒性用四方法分类色；表格主体以黑白规则和少量文字色为主。
paper_style.vector_raster_mix: 43 页 PDF 中图表主要为矢量路径与嵌入字体；Figure 1–2 含栅格图标并与矢量框线/文字混排，其余图表以矢量为主。pdfimages 仅在框架图页观察到栅格图标。
paper_style.style_consistency: 正文与附录共享 Nimbus/Times-like caption 与小字号 DejaVuSans 图表字体、圆点 marker 和浅灰网格；颜色语义在单张图内稳定，但方法色未跨所有图表统一。

design_strengths: 用同一示例把 semantic、episodic、procedural memory 与反馈入口连成可读路径。
位置、框线、标签和箭头共同承担语义，降低对单一颜色的依赖。

caption.text: Figure 2. The framework of MemoryBench includes: (1) Task Provider collects the query q, context c, and evaluation metadata v for each task case; (2) User Simulator simulates human-like feedback and interactions to the LLMsys (which serves as the feedback logs S) on training data; (3) Performance Monitor evaluate the actual performance of LLMsys on the test data.

color.semantic_mapping: 橙色表示 User Simulator/训练反馈，绿色表示 LLMsys，蓝色表示测试交互与 Performance Monitor，灰色表示 Task Provider 和数据路径。

figures.evidence_relation: method architecture → Figure 2 interfaces data generation and evaluation → Figure 3/4 headline comparisons → Appendix A.3 protocols and ablations.
design_strengths: 全宽布局清晰分离训练交互、测试交互和评估路径。

caption.text: Figure 11. Mem0 exhibits severe slowdown during memorization across different tasks. (a) For memorizing the corpus of DialSim-theoffice, the time per entry grows drastically after an initially stable phase, eventually exceeding 20 minutes per entry. (b) A similar pathological slowdown is observed when memorizing dialogues with copy feedback in Legal domain.

figures.data_and_statistics: Mem0 memorization time per sampled corpus entry across DialSim-theoffice and Legal copy-feedback dialogues; each panel uses a different sampling stride and includes a horizontal average reference, with no uncertainty interval.
figures.evidence_relation: Figure 4/Table 19 timing cost → Figure 11 pathological Mem0 slowdown → A.3.8 exclusion rationale and downstream result tables.
design_strengths: 把平均参考线与逐点增长放在同一坐标中，异常增长易见。

tables.label: Table 1

caption.text: Table 1. Benchmarks Categorization and Comparison. Dec., Pro., Sem., Epi., Exp., Imp., Ver., Act. are abbreviations for Declarative, Procedural, Semantic, Episodic, Explicit, Implicit, Verbal, and Action. LiSo is the acronym of Long-input-Short-output, etc.

tables.data_and_statistics: benchmark taxonomy matrix across task formats, memory types, feedback types, and number of cases; no sampling uncertainty.
tables.evidence_relation: method taxonomy → Table 1 positioning of MemoryBench → Figure 1/2 terminology and Tables 2–3 dataset construction.
design_strengths: Multi-level headers compress task/memory/feedback dimensions.
Proposed MemoryBench row is visually separable from prior benchmarks.
design_weaknesses: Dense abbreviations require caption and body decoding.

evidence.label: p.3 Table 1 caption, header, and body

tables.label: Table 2

caption.text: Table 2. The categorization of datasets in MemoryBench in terms of memory types. Declarative, Procedural, Semantic, Episodic are abbreviations for Declarative, Procedural, Semantic (user independent memory), and Episodic memory (user-specific memory).

tables.data_and_statistics: Categorical dataset-by-memory-type matrix: declarative, semantic, episodic, and procedural membership; no numeric estimator.
tables.evidence_relation: Table 3 dataset metadata → Table 2 memory taxonomy → Figure 1 conceptual memory roles and Figure 2 benchmark interface.
design_strengths: Nested header exposes declarative/semantic/episodic/procedural hierarchy.
Checkmark-like categorical cells make coverage scanable.
design_weaknesses: Memory-type abbreviations repeat conceptual distinctions without a visual key inside body.
No indication of mutually exclusive versus overlapping membership in cells.
tables.reusable_pattern: Represent dataset coverage as a compact memory-type matrix with explicit hierarchical headers.

evidence.label: p.14 Table 2 caption, header, and body

tables.label: Table 3

caption.text: Table 3. Details of Datasets in MemoryBench. In the “Task” column, “LiSo” indicates tasks with long inputs and short outputs, using 600 tokens as the threshold to differentiate between long and short. In the “Name” column, “A.K.” refers to “Academic & Knowledge,” “A.E.” to “Academic & Engineering,” “C.D.” to “Creative & Design,” and “P.L.” to “Politics & Law.” In the “Domain” column, “Open” denotes an Open-Domain. In the “Test Metrics” column, “Multi-Metrics” indicates that the dataset includes multiple evaluation metrics.

tables.data_and_statistics: Dataset metadata table: task format, dataset name, domain, language, case count, test metric(s), and average input/output text lengths; counts and descriptive means, no uncertainty.
tables.evidence_relation: Table 3 sampling/metric contract → Tables 8–9 mixture totals → Tables 10–16 domain/task aggregates and raw metrics.
design_strengths: Page-width layout fits long dataset names and metric labels.
Task/domain group rules preserve the sampling taxonomy.
design_weaknesses: Several abbreviations and multi-metric cells are dense.
Average text lengths lack dispersion, so context-length heterogeneity is hidden.
tables.reusable_pattern: Place the dataset contract before result tables and reuse its task/domain labels verbatim.

evidence.label: p.15 Table 3 caption, header, and body

cross_object_system.visual_narrative: Table 1 与 Figures 1–2 先定义 benchmark taxonomy、memory 角色和训练/测试接口；Figure 3–4 给出 off-policy headline 与成本；Tables 10–16 展开 normalized/raw/feedback evidence；Figures 5–14、Tables 17–22 补充 dynamics、failure、action/noise/backbone robustness；Table 23 用单案例收束 qualitative evidence。
cross_object_system.caption_system: Caption 均以 Figure/Table 编号和描述性标题开头；方法与设置通常有 setup/encoding key，少数 caption 直接给 main finding（T7、F11、F12），统计不确定性只在 T13/T14 明确 ± SD。F14 沿用 F13 caption，造成横轴变量错配。
cross_object_system.table_header_system: 结果表反复使用 LLMsys 行、domain/task 多级列头、dataset/metric 原生指标列和 With/Without 差值列；T20 的 domain × action × Average/Z 层级最完整，T12–14 以 domain/dataset 分组保留原始指标语义。
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: Figure 2 的 Task Provider/User Simulator/LLMsys/Monitor 接口连接到 Figure 3–4 headline；T16–18 显式比较 feedback，有 T20–22 的 action/noise/backbone 机制切片，动态轨迹和失败图补充过程证据。
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: 主文 Figure 3 的 aggregate 与 Figure 4 的 timing 分别由 Tables 10–15、19 复现/展开；Figure 2 的 simulator 与 feedback 由 Tables 4–7、16–18、20–22 验证；Table 23 提供主张级 qualitative trace。
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: PDF 嵌入字体确认正文 NimbusRomNo9L/数学字体与图表 DejaVuSans、Arial/TimesNewRoman 混用；字号在密集附录表和小面板内明显收缩，caption 与主文主体较稳定。
cross_object_system.color_consistency: 蓝色常表示主轨迹或 Memory Time，橙色表示 Predict Time，绿色/蓝色/橙色角色色在 Figure 2 稳定；八方法颜色和四方法鲁棒性颜色在不同对象间并非同一映射，需依赖图例或面板标题。

most_reusable_patterns: 全宽架构图先定义数据、反馈和评估边界，再用同一 domain/task 词汇组织 headline 与附录表。
主图给聚合比较，配对表给 normalized alternative、raw metric、dispersion 和 sample-count audit trail。
用匹配的 With/Without、action/noise/backbone 切片与统一多级表头，把机制解释连接到可复现实验条件。
成本图同时报告组成项，并用逐点 slowdown 图解释基线排除或失败。
highest_value_objects: Figure 2：最清楚地定义 benchmark 的角色、训练反馈日志和 test evaluation 接口。
Figure 3 + Tables 10–14：从 headline aggregate 到 normalization/raw/SD 的证据链最完整。
Figure 4 + Table 19 + Figure 11：把性能、成本单位和 Mem0 失败联系起来，但单位需修正。
Table 16–22：覆盖反馈消融、动作噪声和 backbone 条件，支持机制边界审计。
failure_patterns: F14 caption 复用 F13 的 varying S0L 描述，实际横轴为 Gaussian perturbation σ。
Table 19 caption 写 iterations per second，与 Figure 4 及表中 time-like values 的 seconds 语义冲突。
多色方法编码缺少跨图统一映射，灰度输出和小面板中的可辨识度有限。
原始指标表拆成多张且缺少每行样本量/配对不确定性，跨 metric 的整体排序容易被误读。
Table 23 的 retrieved memory/response 使用截断文本，单案例可解释但不可独立验证总体效果。
final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: MemoryBench 以角色架构图定义接口、以 domain/task 聚合图建立 headline、以原始指标/消融/动态/成本附录补足机制证据，但应先修正计时单位与 F14 caption 并统一方法色映射。
